questions.prompt: What does a submodule record in the parent repository?

options.text: A full copy of the other repository's files
A link to another repository at a specific commit (URL + pinned commit)
Only the other repo's latest branch name

questions.explanation: The parent stores the submodule's URL (in .gitmodules) and a pointer to a specific commit — not the submodule's actual contents.

options.text: Replaces large files with small pointer files, storing the content on a separate LFS server
Deletes large files from the working tree

questions.explanation: Git LFS commits a tiny pointer in place of each large file and keeps the real bytes on an LFS server, so the Git repo stays small and fast.

questions.prompt: Which statements are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: A submodule is pinned to a specific commit
Git LFS keeps large binaries out of the main repo history via pointers
Submodules automatically update to the latest upstream commit

questions.explanation: Recursive clone fetches submodule contents, submodules are pinned to a commit, and LFS uses pointers. Submodules do NOT auto-update — you bump and commit the new pointer yourself.

questions.prompt: To clone a repository and fetch its submodules in one step: git clone --recurse-__________ <url>
questions.explanation: git clone --recurse-submodules clones the repo and checks out each submodule at its pinned commit.

questions.prompt: You cloned a project and its `libs/` submodule folder is empty. Why?

options.text: You cloned without --recurse-submodules (or didn't run git submodule update --init)
Submodules can't be cloned at all

questions.explanation: A plain clone brings only the pointer to the submodule commit, not its files. Use --recurse-submodules or git submodule update --init --recursive to populate it.

questions.prompt: Match each item to its role.

pairs.right: A repo pinned inside another at a commit
Set which file patterns LFS manages

questions.explanation: A submodule pins a nested repo, .gitmodules records it, LFS stores large files as pointers, and git lfs track configures the patterns.
